_comment: Green Target legacy ledger import. Analogue of dev/import/legacy-jan-may/account-aliases.json. Every entry here is an audited decision; prepare-staging.mjs fails loudly if the source stops matching it.
_aliasesNote: EMPTY BY DESIGN. Tien Hock needed aliases because its legacy codes had to land in the SHARED public.account_codes, which already contained conflicting ERP codes. Green Target gets its own greentarget.account_codes (handover decision R1), so all 502 legacy codes are imported verbatim with no renaming. Do not add an alias here without user approval.

excludedSections.reason: Static trade-debtor CONTROL section, superseded by the GTDB per-customer detail. Its printed BALANCE C/FWD is 156,782.22, which is the 30-Jun-2026 debtor total (= the June Balance Sheet note 22), not a 1-Jan-2026 opening: the GTDB detail opens at 159,409.32 and moves -2,627.10 to close at exactly 156,782.22. Importing both would double-count the receivable. Same decision as the Tien Hock import made for its own DEBTOR section.

openingDateExceptions.reason: The ONLY section in either workbook whose BALANCE C/FWD is not dated 2026-01-01. It is a static snapshot carrying the 30-Jun-2026 figure with no transaction detail, so the export does not evidence this account's true 1-Jan-2026 opening. It is nonetheless part of the June trade-receivable total that reconciles to 156,782.22. Tien Hock's import carried the same class of exception (THDB SUN at 2026-05-31). RAISE WITH THE USER BEFORE G4 decides which date to anchor it at.

journalFamilies.meaning: CASH / COUNTER SALES INVOICE. Credits revenue only: TGA 'POTONG KAYU/SAMPAH/TONG RENTAL (TONG A)' (906 rows) and TGB 'SISA BATU & TANAH (TONG B)' (109 rows). Particulars read 'INV/NO : 2026/00001 /CD-LIST' or '/CD-CASH'. No cheque reference. THE DEBIT LEG IS NOT PRINTED IN THIS EXPORT - see unbalancedFamilies below.

CREDIT SALES INVOICE to a registered debtor. Fully double-entry ACROSS THE TWO FILES: GTLD credits revenue (WS_OTH 70, TGA 24, WS_OTH4 6) and GTDB debits the debtor (89 rows). Both sides total exactly 46,848.20.

RECEIPT VOUCHER. Always debits the bank PBB_1 (472 GTLD rows, 277,825.30). 49,475.30 of that is credited to GTDB debtors (94 rows) and settles credit sales; the remaining 228,350.00 is the banking of counter cash and its credit leg is not printed - see unbalancedFamilies below. No cheque reference.
CHEQUE PAYMENT VOUCHER. Debits expense/asset accounts, credits PBB_1. EVERY row carries a physical cheque number in column E (e.g. PB350442). Balanced: DR 95,914.55 = CR 95,914.55.
ELECTRONIC BANK PAYMENT. Same shape as PB but column E carries the bank's transaction id (e.g. PBEB26062303512251) rather than a cheque number. Balanced: DR 171,442.29 = CR 171,442.29.

One single electronic payment (half-month salary, 06/2026, 2,400.00) whose reference was keyed 'PBE' instead of 'PBEB'; its column-E value is a PBEB-format bank transaction id. Treated as PBEB. Balanced.
MONTHLY PAYROLL JOURNAL (salary, EPF, SOCSO, SIP accruals across the BWS_*/BWE_*/SS_* families). One per month. Balanced: DR 110,737.50 = CR 110,737.50.
MONTHLY DIRECTORS' REMUNERATION JOURNAL (salary/EPF/SOCSO to BWDR* against the BW_AD* payables). One per month. Balanced: DR 23,299.90 = CR 23,299.90.

JOURNAL VOUCHER. Ten rows are the five monthly bank-charge pairs (DR BWBC / CR PBB_1, Jan-May). The eleventh, JV26/06/77 dated 2026-06-30, is a 720.00 DEBIT to PBB_1 whose particulars cite four counter-sales invoice numbers ('REF : 2026/00338/2026/00365/2026/00527/2026/00583') - it is a cash-sales banking keyed as a JV instead of an RV, and shares the missing credit leg described in unbalancedFamilies.

unbalancedFamilies._summary: ONE structural gap explains every imbalance in both workbooks: the export prints no CASH-IN-HAND account activity. Counter sales credit revenue with no debit; bankings debit the bank with no credit. Nothing else in either file is unbalanced.

cashInHand.chartAccountPresent: CH_REV2 'CAH RECEIVED (2)' exists in the printed GTLD chart but is shown with a 0.00 opening and ZERO transactions.
cashInHand.corroboration: The June Balance Sheet prints 'Cash in hand (note 6) .00', which agrees with the implied 2026-06-30 balance of 0.00. The six implied month-end balances above are a falsifiable prediction that G1 must test against the six Trial Balance scans.
cashInHand.consequence: The 30-Jun-2026 closing trial balance balances EXACTLY (DR = CR = 2,896,809.54) without any adjustment, but the 1-Jan-2026 opening set is short 10,710.00 on the debit side and the Jan-May month-end trial balances do not balance.

duplicateJournalGroups._comment: Handover section 7 asks whether grouping by (journal_ref, entry_date) merges genuinely separate legacy documents. Measured: it does not, materially.
duplicateJournalGroups.note: 1,015 '#/#' rows collapse into 1,011 groups. Populated by prepare-staging.mjs into the validation report as collidingJournalGroups so G4 can review the exact four.

malformedRows._comment: Tien Hock needed line normalizations and had two sections whose balance chain would not walk. Green Target needs none.
malformedRows.note: All 502 sections walk BALANCE C/FWD -> printed close exactly. No control bytes, no split fields, no unparsable balances, no unparsable dates.
